subject: Postdoc position on cod demography in Tromsø, Norway

messages.author: 864675a31b6a7e6b
messages.subject: Postdoc position on cod demography in Tromsø, Norway
parts:
A fully funded 2-year Postdoc position is available at the Institute of Marine Research (IMR), Tromsø, Norway. The successful candidate will investigate phenotypic and demographic changes in coastal cod populations using individual-based data. We are looking for a statistical ecologist, ideally with experience in acoustic telemetry or spatial mark-recapture methods.

 

Application deadline April 30, 2024.

 

For more information and to apply: https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/260670/eco-evolutionary-dynamics-in-the-coastal-zone

 

Project’s website: https://www.codchange-project.com/

 

Please help spread the word!

 

Albert Fernández Chacón (IMR, Tromsø), Esben Moland Olsen (IMR, Flødevigen), Torbjørn Ergon (University of Oslo)
